decisions.reason: Because this HVAC plate heat exchanger is close to the core offer and there is no negative market signal yet, the option value of waiting another year likely exceeds the low cost of keeping it available.

The reported major market share in marine water cooling is a strong positive signal, so management would almost certainly continue this product rather than abandon a promising extension of the established business.
As a marine cooling unit presented on its own page and built on existing capabilities, it still offers upside under uncertainty with limited incremental carrying cost.

This compact oil cooler fits the firm's established engineering base, but the weaker evidence of traction means it is somewhat more at risk even though management would still likely retain it for now.
A dedicated-page launch in finned tubes for air coolers suggests meaningful commitment, and in a growing market the firm would likely preserve this adjacent option while demand information develops.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage the firm's R&D and manufacturing strengths, so absent clear signs of failure the rational choice is to keep the product on the market and learn further.
